headline: Every committed market graph was scanned for a node in this market's 126 admitted postal codes (count below); none of the 36 live markets is in Arizona -- this is the first Arizona market.
a_brand_prefix_is_not_a_market: Marriott's PHX prefix covers the whole Valley -- and Casa Grande -- and never decides membership. A route carries no postal code, so every route is a LEAD with a PRESUMED disposition read off the brand's own slug.

live_identity_names.what_it_is: The normalised canonical name of every identity every registered market publishes. No live market owns an Arizona premises, so a Phoenix row can collide with a live market ONLY by name; the census holds any Phoenix row whose own normalised name is already published elsewhere.

cross_market_name_collision_guard.what_this_order_does_about_it: MEASURES it and hands the strings to the census reconciliation as a named guard, which HOLDS rather than silently drops any hit. This order does NOT edit the shared exclusion file.

provider_history.pay_once_rule: Every URL this order is about to buy is checked against these ledgers first.
provider_history.refusals_are_treated_as_stale: A prior refusal ages in days and is re-probed, never inherited.

owned_osm_extract: none -- no Arizona extract was owned; the Geofabrik Arizona extract was downloaded by this order (see the OSM lane).
